scripts.features:
hi this is a project make by me (If you are coming here to give a skid, Im fine with it. I used a bit of chatlgbt to make the logic so that when it dies, the script still works.)

if you find smth like errors say to my dm in discord : jalanbipallv22_75999
scripts.script:
getgenv().AutoHit = true

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remote"):WaitForChild("Event"):WaitForChild("Combat"):WaitForChild("M1")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local HumanoidRootPart

local function updateCharacter()
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	HumanoidRootPart = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

updateCharacter()
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(updateCharacter)

local function getClosestMob()
	local closest, dist = nil, math.huge
	for _, mob in ipairs(Workspace.Live.MobModel:GetChildren()) do
		if mob:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and mob:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and mob.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
			local mag = (mob.HumanoidRootPart.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
			if mag < dist then
				dist = mag
				closest = mob
			end
		end
	end
	return closest
end

task.spawn(function()
	while getgenv().AutoHit do
		task.wait()
		if HumanoidRootPart then
			local target = getClosestMob()
			if target then
				Remote:FireServer({ target:GetAttribute("UUID") or target.Name })
			end
		end
	end
end)

How to Use Anti-Detection (God Mode)

Stand close enough to the NPC to interact, but far enough that the NPC does not detect or attack you.
Press E (or the on-screen "Toggle Combat Mode" button) five times while moving slightly left and right, until the status reads INACTIVE.
To let NPCs attack other mobs again, die/respawn in the game to reset the state.

Tip: Make sure the status stays INACTIVE before you move away.
